basic_info.description: Incredible investment opportunity to own a three-bedroom, three-bath, top floor, semi-attached, two-level contemporary condominium with panoramic views in the highly coveted Potrero Hill district of San Francisco! The main level features an open living/dining/kitchen area with fireplace, and a wall of windows with cascading natural light showcasing spectacular views of San Francisco. On this same level are two spacious bedrooms, one with a private deck/patio access, and the other with en-suite bathroom.  The upper level highlights a secluded master bedroom suite complete with fireplace, roof deck access with views, a private bathroom, wet bar, and plenty of closet space.  There is deeded side-by side garage parking for this unit and shared access to the garden/backyard area. All the decks on the rear side of the building have been replaced along with    extensive siding repair. 1320 De Haro Street sold on 2/24/25 (MLS# 425007426) and it was in similar condition to 1322 De Haro Street. Do not miss this truly special offering that is close to world class restaurants, cafes, shopping, parks, playgrounds, Chase Center, Oracle Park, Crane Cove Park, HWY 101/280 and more!
